cloud_engineer.question: Can you walk me through your experience with cloud platforms, and why you chose Cloud Engineering as your primary career track?

Suppose our web application needs to handle unpredictable viral traffic spikes while minimizing idle costs during the night. How would you architect this on AWS using EC2, Auto Scaling, and Application Load Balancer?
expected_topics: Auto Scaling Group (ASG) target tracking policies

cloud_engineer.question: How do you architect a secure VPC from scratch? Detail your subnet design, route tables, and how private instances safely access the internet for OS security updates.
expected_topics: Public vs Private Subnets across 2+ AZs
NAT Gateway placement in public subnet

cloud_engineer.question: How does AWS IAM enforce the Principle of Least Privilege? What is the difference between an IAM Role and an IAM User, and when would you use an IAM Instance Profile?
expected_topics: IAM Roles with temporary STS credentials
Avoiding hardcoded secret keys in code or AMI

cloud_engineer.question: Compare Amazon S3 and Amazon EBS. How do you implement automated lifecycle rules on S3 to cost-optimize petabyte-scale data storage?
expected_topics: S3 Standard, Infrequent Access (IA), Glacier, Deep Archive
S3 Lifecycle policies transitioning objects based on age

cloud_engineer.question: When would you choose a Serverless architecture using AWS Lambda and API Gateway over containerized microservices running on ECS or EKS?
expected_topics: Pricing model: pay per request vs provisioned cluster costs

cloud_engineer.question: How do Docker and Kubernetes fit into modern cloud deployment? Explain how a Kubernetes Deployment manages rolling updates with zero downtime.

A mission-critical microservice in production is reporting elevated 504 Gateway Timeout errors. How do you systematically use CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs, and distributed tracing to pinpoint whether the issue is in the load balancer, application pod, or backend database?
expected_topics: CloudWatch metrics: target response time, HTTP 5XX counts
X-Ray traces isolating slow database query
VPC Flow logs checking network drops
Application logs in CloudWatch Logs Insights

software_developer.question: Tell me about yourself, your core programming languages, and the most technically challenging software project you have built.
How do you decide between using an Array, a Linked List, and a Hash Map when designing an in-memory data store? What are their time and space complexity trade-offs?
expected_topics: Lookup, insertion, and deletion Big-O complexities
Memory cache locality of contiguous arrays
Dynamic resizing overhead in dynamic arrays

software_developer.question: Explain the Single Responsibility Principle and Dependency Inversion Principle from SOLID. How do they help you write maintainable, testable code?
expected_topics: One reason to change per class/module
High-level modules depending on interfaces rather than concrete implementations
Dependency Injection facilitating mock objects in unit tests

software_developer.question: How do relational databases maintain data consistency under high concurrent read/write traffic? Explain ACID properties and transaction isolation levels.
expected_topics: Read Uncommitted, Read Committed, Repeatable Read, Serializable
Dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, and phantom reads

software_developer.question: Describe your strategy for writing unit tests and integration tests. What constitutes effective test coverage, and why can 100% line coverage still miss critical bugs?
expected_topics: Unit testing isolated business logic vs Integration testing service boundaries

software_developer.question: You are tasked with designing a RESTful API for a high-volume social media notification feed. How would you design the endpoints, handle pagination, and ensure low latency?
expected_topics: Idempotent HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
Cursor-based pagination vs offset pagination for real-time streams
Asynchronous background processing using message queues

managerial.question: Tell me about a time you led a team through an ambitious technical project with ambiguous requirements and tight deadlines. How did you organize the roadmap?
How do you handle a team member who is technically competent but frequently misses deadlines and disrupts team communication?
expected_topics: Escalation framework only if non-compliance persists

managerial.question: Describe a situation where a major client or stakeholder changed product requirements two days before a scheduled release. How did you react and guide your team?
expected_topics: Negotiating phased delivery (launch MVP now, add changes in phase 2)
Shielding team from panic while maintaining stakeholder trust

managerial.question: How do you balance investing time into refactoring technical debt versus pushing new features requested by product marketing?
expected_topics: Translating technical debt into business risk (downtime, slow feature velocity, bugs)
Allocating dedicated bandwidth (e.g. 20% tech debt budget per sprint)

technical.question: Could you introduce your technical background, your favorite programming stack, and why you enjoy engineering systems?
Explain the time and space complexity of QuickSort and MergeSort. In what real-world situations would you choose MergeSort over QuickSort?
expected_topics: QuickSort average O(N log N) vs worst-case O(N^2)
MergeSort guaranteed O(N log N) but requires O(N) auxiliary space
MergeSort for Linked Lists or external sorting of massive disk files

technical.question: What is the difference between Clustered and Non-Clustered Indexes in a relational database? How does indexing impact INSERT and UPDATE performance?
expected_topics: Clustered index determines physical table storage order (1 per table)
Non-clustered index creates separate B+ tree with row pointers
Accelerates SELECT queries but adds write overhead on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE

technical.question: How does an operating system manage process scheduling and avoid CPU starvation? Explain Round Robin and Multi-Level Feedback Queue scheduling.
expected_topics: MLFQ dynamically adjusting priority based on I/O vs CPU bound behavior

technical.question: What are the key trade-offs between Monolithic architecture and Microservices? When should an engineering team NOT transition to microservices?
expected_topics: Monolith: simple deployment, ACID transactions, low network latency
Microservices: independent deployment, domain boundary scaling, tech stack flexibility
Microservices complexity: network latency, distributed transactions, observability overhead, operational cost
